title: March of the Machine | Episode 8: Wrenn and Eight

entities.name: Wrenn
entities.description: A dryad planeswalker who grafts herself onto the Invasion Tree, finds the sapling Eight, and opens a portal that brings Teferi and Zhalfir's army to New Phyrexia at great cost to herself.

entities.name: Eight
entities.description: A shy sapling, the soul of the tree whose branches bridge planes, found by Wrenn in the dark within Realmbreaker; he grows under her song.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: The Invasion Tree's preferred name, a Phyrexian tree filled with a thousand screaming voices that insists Wrenn does not belong.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker who carries Wrenn to the tree, is strangled by Nissa and later helps Wrenn shape her fire.

entities.name: Koth of the Hammer
entities.description: A Mirran planeswalker who shields the group with metal and builds a barricade.

entities.name: Melira
entities.description: A wounded Mirran who passes Wrenn to the tree and lends her strength with white magic.

entities.name: Phyrexian Nissa Revane
entities.description: A Phyrexianized elf who rides above the bridge on copper roots, hunting Chandra and Wrenn with barbed vines.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker found by Wrenn in a hidden place out of time, at the side of a queen, who agrees to help and brings an army.

entities.name: Queen of Zhalfir
entities.description: The queen beside Teferi in the hidden place, who calls Wrenn an efreet and leads her people as they ready for war.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A winged angel who strikes Nissa with light, catches Chandra and later fights the Grand Praetor.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: The Phyrexian Grand Praetor who fights Elspeth as the portal opens.

entities.name: Mirrans
entities.description: The remaining Mirran fighters who defend the barricade at the tree.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Thousands of Phyrexians pressing toward the tree and then pouring through the portal.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: A plane hidden out of time, bright and peaceful, which Teferi's people called to war defend.

entities.name: Teferi's people
entities.description: The armed Zhalfirin warriors, mages and scholars who answer Teferi's call.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The scoured plane of machines where the Invasion Tree stands and where Wrenn expects to die.

entities.name: Invasion Tree
entities.description: The giant white-plated tree Wrenn must graft onto to reach Teferi.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: A plane where Chandra and Wrenn once talked about controlling fire.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A plane whose oaks Wrenn sings of.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A plane whose floating pines Wrenn sings of.

events.summary: Carried by Chandra toward the Invasion Tree, Wrenn fears she cannot do what everyone relies on her to do, as the tree does not answer her.
events.quote: That is what truly frightens Wrenn: the possibility that she may not be able to do what everyone is relying upon her to do.

events.summary: Koth shields the group from a rain of needles as Chandra, struggling, carries Wrenn.
events.quote: Koth levitates the metal beneath their feet to a shield over their heads.

events.summary: Nissa's barbed vine goes through Melira's stomach and attacks Chandra and Wrenn.
events.quote: the other end of the tendril's gone clean through Melira's stomach.

events.summary: Koth creates a metal barricade to stop Nissa, who strides over the bridge on cable-like roots.
events.quote: Metal groans up and grows, forming a barrier to stop Nissa's approach.

events.summary: Nissa catches Chandra by the ankle and hoists her up; Wrenn falls and the Mirrans pass her hand to hand toward the tree.
events.quote: Nissa lifting her by the ankle with a long and brassy root.

events.summary: Nissa strangles Chandra with vines while Melira helps Wrenn up to the observation platform.
events.quote: Vines wrap about Chandra's throat.

events.summary: Melira places Wrenn against the tree and lends her strength before collapsing against it.
events.quote: magic ebbs from Melira's hand, glowing a faint white.

events.summary: Wrenn melds into Realmbreaker, who rejects her; oil floods her senses and she begins to sing in defiance.
events.quote: Wrenn begins to sing.

events.summary: Wrenn's fire flares and burns Realmbreaker's voices and herself.
events.quote: A flare within her belly, the smell of burning oak.

events.summary: A golden angel strikes Nissa with light, forcing her to drop Chandra, whom the angel sets on the platform.
events.quote: the angel catches Chandra and sets her on the platform.

events.summary: Chandra recalls their talk on Dominaria and pulls Wrenn's fire into herself so Wrenn can shape it.
events.quote: Fire's going to burn, no matter what you do, but you can shape it if you try.

events.summary: In a vision, Wrenn sings to find a lonely sapling in a lake of black oil and shields him with flaming trees.
events.quote: Flaming trees grow to the size of mountains

events.summary: Eight grows tall, and Wrenn names him Eight and resolves to bring him to Teferi.
events.quote: Hello, Eight , she says. Let's introduce you to Teferi.

events.summary: Wrenn and Eight tear holes across planes and see the Phyrexian invasion everywhere.
events.quote: Fires churning in his belly, Eight reaches for new planes.

events.summary: Wrenn and Eight get lost deliberately, tracing Teferi's magic to a hidden place out of time and finding him at a gathering of peaceful people.
events.quote: Among them—standing at the queen's side—is Teferi.

events.summary: Wrenn calls to Teferi, who vouches for her to the queen and asks how he can help.
events.quote: "She's a friend of mine."

events.summary: Wrenn asks Teferi to come to New Phyrexia to help the losing fight.
events.quote: "We need you on New Phyrexia.

events.summary: Wrenn realizes she can push planes together to bring Zhalfir into New Phyrexia, at the cost of herself and Eight, and asks Teferi to bring his friends.
events.quote: "Wait," she says. "Don't come alone. Bring your friends."

events.summary: Wrenn and Teferi say a farewell as thousands answer his call.
events.quote: "Whatever remains of me will always remember my friend, Wrenn,"

events.summary: Wrenn grows a massive portal as Elspeth is flung through the gate by a war engine, and the Phyrexian army pours through into Zhalfir's peaceful land.
events.quote: The monstrosity flings the angel through the gate

events.summary: Zhalfir's warriors cross the portal led by Teferi, ready for war after many years.
events.quote: It has been many years since they were called to war—but Zhalfir stands ready.

relations.note: They fight together and Chandra shapes Wrenn's fire
relations.quote: "You're doing such a good job, Wrenn."

relations.note: Teferi calls Wrenn his friend and a hero
relations.quote: "Whatever remains of me will always remember my friend, Wrenn,"
But she does know she's got a fine new partner.

relations.note: Melira carries Wrenn and lends her strength
relations.quote: "But I can help you with this, at least a little."

relations.note: Koth shouts he has her back
Teferi stands at the queen's side and vouches for Wrenn
relations.quote: But Teferi lays a comforting hand on the queen's shoulder.

relations.note: The golden angel fights the Grand Praetor
relations.quote: A golden angel beats back the Grand Praetor

relations.note: Realmbreaker insists she does not belong
Eight is the soul of the tree
relations.quote: He's the soul of the tree, after all
